hook: Give your customer their own screen showing exactly what they're being charged.
target_audience: Retail and food-service shop owners who want a supermarket-style checkout experience - Premium subscribers.
problem: A customer at the counter has no way to see what they're actually being charged until the receipt prints.
solution: A second, lightweight page (customer.html) mirrors the live cart/order state in real time, meant for a second monitor or a screen facing the customer. This is a Premium feature - app.html's applyPremiumLocks() keeps it locked until Premium is active.
